### ⚡ About Me

> **Full-Stack Software Developer & BICT (Hons) Undergraduate** based in **Batticaloa, Sri Lanka**.  
> Third-year undergraduate at the **Faculty of Technology, University of Ruhuna** (2023 – 2027).  
> I engineer practical web applications, secure REST APIs, and database-driven business systems — focusing on clean architecture, automated testing, relational integrity, and containerized deployments.  
> **Philosophy:** *Operational > Decorative &bull; Maintainable > Clever &bull; Secure by Default*

### 🚀 Selected Repositories & Architecture

| Project | Stack | Operational Problem Solved |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **[Shoe Bank](https://github.com/HajithMohamed/Footwear_Business_Management_System)** | `PHP` · `MySQL` · `Tailwind` · `Docker` | **Footwear Business Management:** Inventory control, customer credit, cheque tracking, OCR receipts & multi-ledger financial reports. |
| **[Saga Elite](https://github.com/Hz-Labs-studio/Saga-Elite-Web-project)** | `React` · `Redux` · `Node.js` · `Express` · `MongoDB` | **Full-Stack E-Commerce:** 4-member collaborative architecture, JWT authentication, real-time Socket.IO events, and automated Playwright CI. |
| **[BenchBook](https://github.com/HajithMohamed/Medical-Lab-Resource-Reservation-System)** | `Next.js` · `TypeScript` · `PostgreSQL` · `Prisma` | **Laboratory Resource Reservation:** PostgreSQL reservation conflict integrity constraints, schedule slot locks, and automated Vitest suites. |
| **[BloodBridge](https://github.com/akalanka001/-BloodBridge--ADBMS)** | `PostgreSQL` · `PL/pgSQL` · `React` · `Docker` | **Advanced DBMS System:** Procedural SQL functions, atomic inventory triggers, and authorization safeguards ([PR #7 Merged](https://github.com/akalanka001/-BloodBridge--ADBMS/pull/7)). |
| **[HZ Labs Studio Platform](https://github.com/HajithMohamed/my_portfoli_website)** | `Next.js 16` · `NestJS` · `Prisma` · `PostgreSQL` | **Digital Studio CMS & Analytics:** Live GitHub contribution stream sync, authenticated admin portal, and responsive HUD design. |
| **[NextGen Mobiles](https://github.com/HajithMohamed/NEXTGEN---Sri-Lankan-Mobile-Shop-eCommerce-Website)** | `PHP` · `MySQL` · `Bootstrap` | **Retail Operations Platform:** Replaced manual stock tracking with relational database inventory, supplier logs & warranty tracking. |
| **[Nano Zillas — OOP](https://github.com/HajithMohamed/Nano-_Zillas_Java_Project)** | `Java` · `OOP` · `UML` · `SOLID` | **Clean Domain Modeling:** Strict adherence to SOLID principles, modular class inheritance hierarchies, and polymorphic design. |
